businessGoal: Provide users the ability to sort products in the product overview section.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the sorting dropdown is displayed on the product overview page.
Verify that the sorting dropdown includes the options: Name (A - Z), Name (Z - A), Price (High - Low), Price (Low - High).
Verify that selecting a sort option reloads the product grid with products ordered according to the selected sort.

manual.reason: The story describes visible browser behavior related to the sorting functionality.

api.reason: Sorting behavior can potentially be validated through the application's API by checking the order of returned products.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria mention UI elements like the sorting dropdown and product grid.
